profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Thoughtful, deliberate, and versatile product-minded software engineer. My professional motto is the same as my home state's motto: "Esse quam videri" - "To be, rather than to seem".

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Consultant
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description: Rails, JavaScript, AWS, and AI applications development and consulting.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Power Auctions provides economics and software development expertise in implementing high stakes auctions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Agari is on a mission to ensure humanity prevails over evil in digital communications, particularly in the realm of email security. I am helping build out the Agari Phishing Response product; a tool that allows SOC analysts to investigate, triage, and remove malicious emails from their organizations' inboxes. Working on a Rails and Ember.js web application and Python data pipeline in an AWS environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: SkillsEngine, out of Texas State Technical College (TSTC), is working to align the workforce skill needs of industry with educators' curriculum. I worked on a Rails/React/Ember.js web application serving educational institutions and industry contributors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Mapzen was funded by Samsung to build open-source software tools for open map data. I developed new features for the Transitland project - an open-source data repository for transit data feeds from around the globe submitted by independent contributors. I worked on Transitland's Rails web and background processing application, and data debugging and inspection tools in Ember.js.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked for the NextBus subsidiary. Developed software tools in Python to process raw transit data for ingestion into the NextBus prediction system.  Developed internal and public-facing web tools in Java and JavaScript/Backbone.js used by passengers and QA analysts to visualize transit vehicle positions.

positions.title: Transportation Data Analyst
positions.description: Worked for the NextBus subsidiary, which was acquired by Cubic from WebTech Wireless. Utilized GIS software and developed ETL-like Python tools to process schedule and geo-data. Developed software prototypes to enhance and streamline team workflow. Worked with transit agency clients in communicating system requirements and defects.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Wrote a lot of Perl code to analyze metagenomic data. Conducted a molecular clock using MCMC methods from bioinformatics software tools.
